identity.name: Haven & Paw
identity.tagline: Every animal deserves a safe place to land.
identity.one_line_description: Haven & Paw is a civic-minded animal rescue shelter connecting abandoned and at-risk animals with loving homes through transparent operations, community campaigns, and trusted partnerships.
identity.target_audience: Local community members, prospective adopters, recurring donors, corporate partners, and civic-minded volunteers who believe in accountable, mission-driven animal welfare.

pages.title: Home
pages.goal: Establish Haven & Paw as the community's trusted animal rescue institution, orient first-time visitors to the mission and urgency, and guide them toward adoption, donation, or volunteering — anchored by an unmistakable civic arrival moment.
pages.meta_description: Haven & Paw is your community's animal rescue shelter — rescuing, rehabilitating, and rehoming animals in need. Adopt, donate, or volunteer today.

sections.intent: Anchor the visitor with a strong civic arrival moment that communicates the shelter's purpose and urgency without melodrama — a steady, institutional confidence that says 'we are here, we are doing the work.'
sections.headline: A Safe Place for Every Animal That Needs One
sections.subheadline: Haven & Paw rescues, rehabilitates, and rehomes animals across the region. Open every day because animals need us every day.

sections.intent: Quickly orient visitors to the three pillars of the shelter's work — rescue, rehabilitation, and rehoming — so they understand the full scope of the mission before scrolling deeper.
sections.headline: Rescue. Rehabilitate. Rehome.
sections.subheadline: Three commitments that guide every decision we make.

items.title: Emergency Rescue
items.description: We respond to calls for abandoned, injured, and at-risk animals 365 days a year, coordinating with local authorities and community members.

items.title: Medical Rehabilitation
items.description: Every animal in our care receives veterinary assessment, treatment, and the time they need to recover before meeting their future family.

items.title: Responsible Rehoming
items.description: Our adoption process matches animals with the right households — thorough, caring, and designed for lasting placements.

sections.intent: Close the home page with a confident civic call to action that invites the visitor to become part of the shelter's community — a single purposeful flourish that converts orientation into commitment.
sections.headline: Animals Are Waiting. Your Help Makes the Difference.
sections.subheadline: Adopt a companion, donate to our operations, or give your time as a volunteer. Every action matters.

pages.title: Adoption Campaign
pages.goal: Present the shelter's current animals available for adoption in a clear, structured way that builds emotional connection and civic responsibility, and drives visitors toward completing an adoption inquiry.
pages.meta_description: Browse animals currently available for adoption at Haven & Paw. Dogs, cats, and small animals waiting for their forever homes.

sections.intent: Set the tone for the adoption experience — warm but grounded, institutional but human — so visitors feel they are entering a trusted, well-run process.
sections.headline: Find Your Next Family Member
sections.subheadline: Every animal listed here has been rescued, assessed, and cleared for adoption. They are ready. Are you?

sections.intent: Showcase featured animals available for adoption with enough detail to spark genuine connection, letting the profiles do the storytelling with quiet confidence.
sections.headline: Meet the Animals Looking for Homes

items.title: Biscuit — Labrador Mix, 3 years
items.description: Gentle, house-trained, and great with children. Biscuit was surrendered when his owner relocated and has been with us for six weeks.

items.title: Mira — Domestic Shorthair Cat, 2 years
items.description: Independent but curious, Mira does well in quieter homes. She arrived as a stray and has fully recovered from a minor respiratory illness.

items.title: Theo — Beagle, 5 years
items.description: A loyal companion who loves routine walks and calm evenings. Theo was transferred from an overcrowded municipal shelter.

items.title: Clover — Rabbit, 1 year
items.description: Playful and social, Clover is ideal for families with older children or adults seeking a low-maintenance companion.

sections.intent: Build trust in the adoption process by walking prospective adopters through the steps clearly and institutionally — reducing anxiety and increasing follow-through.
sections.headline: A Process Built Around Lasting Matches
sections.subheadline: We take adoption seriously because the animals depend on it.
sections.body: Our adoption process begins with a brief application form, followed by a meet-and-greet at the shelter. Our team reviews each application to ensure the match is right for both the animal and the household. Most adoptions are finalized within five to seven business days. We remain available for post-adoption support at no cost.

pages.title: Our Impact Data
pages.goal: Demonstrate Haven & Paw's accountability and civic credibility through transparent operational data, reinforcing donor and partner confidence with numbers that feel alive and meaningful.
pages.meta_description: Explore Haven & Paw's rescue and adoption statistics, operational transparency reports, and year-over-year impact data.

sections.intent: Frame the data page as an act of institutional transparency — we share our numbers because we believe the community deserves to know exactly what their support achieves.
sections.headline: The Numbers Behind Our Mission
sections.subheadline: We publish our impact data because trust is built on evidence, not promises.

sections.intent: Let the key annual metrics feel alive as they enter view — each number a civic proof point that validates the shelter's work and invites continued investment.
sections.headline: Measured Progress, Year After Year

items.description: Animals rescued this year from abandonment, injury, or overcrowded municipal facilities.
Successful adoptions completed, placing animals into screened and approved homes.
Live release rate — the percentage of animals in our care that leave through adoption, transfer, or return to owner.
Active volunteers who contributed time, skills, and care to our operations this year.

sections.intent: Contextualize the numbers with a plain-language operational summary that reinforces Haven & Paw's institutional integrity and responsible stewardship of community resources.
sections.headline: Every Dollar Accounted For
sections.subheadline: Our operating budget is community-funded and publicly reported.
sections.body: Approximately 68% of all funds received go directly to animal care — veterinary services, food, housing, and behavioral support. 18% supports shelter operations and staffing. 14% is invested in outreach, adoption campaigns, and community education. We publish a full annual report each January and make it available to anyone who asks.

pages.title: Partners & Community
pages.goal: Build institutional credibility by showcasing the network of civic organizations, veterinary partners, and corporate supporters that trust and sustain Haven & Paw, while inviting new partnerships.
pages.meta_description: Meet the civic organizations, veterinary practices, and community businesses that partner with Haven & Paw to support animal rescue in our region.

sections.intent: Establish that Haven & Paw operates within a wider civic ecosystem — this is not a lone organization but a trusted node in a community-wide commitment to animal welfare.
sections.headline: We Don't Do This Alone
sections.subheadline: Haven & Paw works alongside veterinary practices, civic organizations, and local businesses who share our commitment to animal welfare.

sections.intent: Present current partners with enough context to validate the shelter's civic standing and signal to prospective partners the quality of the network they would be joining.
sections.headline: Organizations That Stand With Us

items.title: Riverside Veterinary Clinic
items.description: Provides discounted veterinary services and emergency medical care for all animals entering our facility.

items.title: City Animal Control Division
items.description: Our primary municipal partner for intake coordination, emergency response, and stray animal transfer.

items.title: Greenfield Pet Supply Co.
items.description: Donates food, bedding, and supplies monthly, covering approximately 30% of our annual supply costs.

items.title: Northside Community Foundation
items.description: Provides annual grant funding that supports our low-income adoption assistance program.

items.title: Regional SPCA Network
items.description: Coordinates inter-shelter animal transfers to reduce overcrowding and expand placement opportunities across the region.

items.title: Westbrook High School
items.description: Sends student volunteers each semester through their community service program, contributing hundreds of hours annually.

sections.intent: Invite prospective partners to enter a conversation — a direct, civic-toned close that makes joining the partnership network feel like a natural and responsible choice.
sections.headline: Your Organization Can Make a Lasting Difference
sections.subheadline: We welcome partnerships with veterinary practices, civic organizations, foundations, and businesses aligned with our mission.
sections.body: Whether you can offer in-kind donations, grant funding, volunteer programs, or professional services, there is a meaningful role for your organization at Haven & Paw. We formalize all partnerships with a simple agreement and publish partner names in our annual report.

pages.title: Donate
pages.goal: Convert motivated visitors into donors by making the giving process feel trustworthy, direct, and meaningful — closing the site's civic story with a confident, purposeful call to act.
pages.meta_description: Support Haven & Paw with a one-time or recurring donation. Every contribution funds direct animal care, emergency rescue, and community adoption programs.

sections.intent: Frame the donation page as a civic act — not charity, but community investment — so donors feel the weight and dignity of what they are contributing to.
sections.headline: Your Donation Funds Real Rescue Work
sections.subheadline: No overhead bloat. No vague promises. Your contribution goes directly to the animals and the people caring for them.

sections.intent: Show donors exactly what their money does at specific giving levels, making the impact concrete and reducing hesitation through institutional specificity.
sections.headline: Every Amount Has a Direct Impact

items.title: $25 — One Week of Food
items.description: Covers a full week of nutritionally appropriate food for one animal in our care.

items.title: $75 — Vaccination & Microchip
items.description: Funds a complete vaccination course and microchipping for one animal before adoption.

items.title: $150 — Emergency Veterinary Visit
items.description: Covers the cost of an emergency intake exam and initial treatment for a newly rescued animal.

items.title: $500 — Monthly Shelter Operations
items.description: Contributes to one month of utilities, cleaning supplies, and facility maintenance for the shelter.

sections.intent: Provide a clear, friction-free giving form that reinforces trust through simplicity and institutional tone — a confident final flourish that makes completing the donation feel right and easy.
sections.headline: Make Your Contribution
sections.subheadline: Choose a one-time or monthly gift. All donations are tax-deductible. You will receive a receipt by email.
sections.body: Haven & Paw is a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization. Tax ID available upon request. For questions about major gifts, planned giving, or in-kind donations, contact our development team directly.
